environment: Node vm with a minimal local DOM substitute; no real browser, legacy JSP, network, service or file download.

results.name: Initial zero rows; defaults preserved; added row controls and alternating colors
Deletion removes only selected row and recolors retained row
Empty ID or policy shows exact first-row alert and leaves input/results intact
Duplicate check in earlier nonempty row precedes later blank-policy check
Zero-row export reaches boundary without alert
Whitespace passes exact-empty front guard; multiline remains unmodified
Review acceptance writes results before download-boundary state; no file generation
Review rejection writes known synthetic per-row text without download
Editing inputs and options leaves existing export result text
Review reply injection requires prior export boundary

limits: Does not test layout, native maxlength/input/Enter/alert behavior, focus, keyboard, CSS, browser events, console or network monitor.
Does not test missing external message frames, conditional information protection, trusted context, watermark, target envelopes or binary transfer.
